governing_spec.section: ## GOVERNANCE-JSON-ISOLATION-CORRECTIVE-001 — Close non-journal governance JSON store lost updates
governing_spec.finding: F09 · Governance JSON store 會遺失第二實例未看到的資料

two_instance_lost_update_prevention.implementation: services/governance/record_store.py: JsonGovernanceRecordStore upgraded with re-entrant POSIX file locking (_FileLock using fcntl.flock), fresh disk reload on read and write (_refresh()), and atomic file replacement (_save() with unique temporary file .tmp.<pid>.<uuid>, fsync, and os.replace). Multiple instances pointing to the same file coordinate safely without lost updates.

multiprocess_concurrency.implementation: services/governance/record_store.py: Independent OS processes writing distinct records concurrently coordinate via POSIX file locking on .<storage_name>.flock, preserving 100% of all distinct records without dropping or corrupting data.

insert_if_absent_duplicate_rejection.implementation: services/governance/record_store.py: insert_if_absent re-reads fresh state under file lock and in-process RLock, returning (True, record) for the winning insert and (False, canonical) for all concurrent or subsequent attempts with matching ID.

compare_and_set_version_conflict.implementation: services/governance/record_store.py: compare_and_set re-reads fresh state under file lock, verifying exact equality with expected_record before atomic write. Concurrent mutations with stale expected records fail closed, returning (False, current_record).

fresh_reads_across_instances.implementation: services/governance/record_store.py: get() and list_all() reload from disk under file lock via _coordinate(), ensuring writes from any process or instance are immediately observed by other long-lived instances without restart.

failed_write_restart_durability.implementation: services/governance/record_store.py: Unserializable payloads or filesystem errors during save restore in-memory state and preserve previous on-disk data without partial or uncommitted corruption. Atomic os.replace ensures readers never observe partial files.

four_mounted_consumers_isolation.implementation: services/governance/main.py: freeze_orders and rollbacks write endpoints coordinated via store.lock() and in-process lock during entire read-modify-write transition. human_gate_decisions backed by GovernanceHumanGateDecisionStore enforces insert_if_absent on creation and CAS put_if_matches on signatures. consultation_handoffs backed by consultation_handoff_store enforces insert_if_absent idempotency across independent instances.
